column1: # drift-symbols.tsv — content claims the corpus makes about host files.
#   line = a number  → assert the ERE matches exactly once, on that line
#   line = #N        → count pin: assert the ERE matches exactly N lines
#                      (4th col `shape` on a NOHASH file: every non-comment
#                      line must itself be an assignment — dotenv shape)
#                      (used where naming the matched text would leak: op.env)
# --pin refreshes a recorded line only while the ERE still matches exactly
# once; GONE or ambiguous aborts without writing. Never add a value here.
